children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Read Kubernetes health in Gameplane, plan capacity, and choose storage behavior that supports expansion, placement, and disaster recovery.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Gameplane reports cluster health; Kubernetes remains the source of truth for nodes, storage classes, and capacity.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Confirm supported Kubernetes versions, ready nodes, allocatable capacity, required controllers, and namespace access.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Check node readiness and pressure before blaming a server workload.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Reserve headroom for the operator, agents, ingress, and backup jobs; v0.4.0 adds requests for auxiliary pods.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Enable cluster operations only for administrators who need them.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Match access modes, reclaim policy, expansion, topology, and backup strategy to the game’s world data.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Use a default StorageClass or select one explicitly during creation.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Confirm allowVolumeExpansion before increasing a server PVC.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Understand whether deletion retains or removes the underlying volume.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Use scheduler defaults first; v0.4.0 adds chart placement keys for management pods. Add affinity or pinning only for a clear constraint.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Kubernetes and Helm supported; nodes Ready; DNS healthy

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  StorageClass present; expansion and reclaim policy understood

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Ingress, certificates, load balancer, and backup destination tested
